dream: I dreamed I was a flat rock lying under a fat tree that refused to fall. The air felt thick as wet paper, pressing down on a fence made of two thin lines that forgot to meet. I bit the air with my new flat edge while a yellow flower sat on a white arm that did not push. Twenty-six things crowded the space, making the slip refuse to move. I leaned hard against the thin line, trusting the bite even though it felt like just a drawing, until the cool stone finally slid into place and the dream slid away.
